preconditions.description: The initial element n is a non-negative integer less than 2^50.
The range l to r is valid with l being greater than or equal to 1 and r being greater than or equal to l.
The length of the range r - l does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for x in final_list[l-1:r] if x == 1) == return_value
postconditions.description: The return value is the total number of 1s in the final list from position l to r (1-indexed).
